title: Research (no κ claim): exact ten-H1 floor for an eight-field helper block
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proves an exact **10 H1 minimum** for the dependency-closed eight-field backward helper-300 block at zero-based events **[9044,9116)** of the selected #5413 provider. The current block attains the minimum. This rules out the proposed `H1 + H1 → H2` saving in this particular neighborhood; **no κ improvement is claimed**.

The proof permits arbitrary finite rational ADD/SCALE factorizations, temporary basis changes, scalar order and intermediate binary subspaces. It fixes the eight arbitrary entering fields and their entry/exit frames, and requires monotone climbs. Auxiliary fields, new warps, descents, chart-changing exchanges, cross-column conversions and changed boundary contracts are outside scope.

The obstruction is a transfer-rank cut: if either of the two zero-start helpers jumps directly to its terminal plane, only one carrier can transmit their two-dimensional entering information to other terminal planes, whereas the exact backward outputs require rank two. Both helpers therefore need two H1 climbs; the six line-start fields need one each, giving `2 + 2 + 6 = 10 H1`.

Adds only `research/helper300-eight-field-floor/`: [written proof](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77d29520c4f90a65787873d6becc205796630c23/research/helper300-eight-field-floor/PROOF.md), [source-bound exact certificate](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77d29520c4f90a65787873d6becc205796630c23/research/helper300-eight-field-floor/RESULT.json), two separately authored checkers, and registered research metadata. Physical all-width interpretation remains conditional on the inherited native chart contract. This is neither a whole-provider lower bound nor a formal-kernel verification.

## Task and overlap

- **Base:** canonical main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`, priority revision 7; refreshed before submission.
- **Publication head:** `77d29520c4f90a65787873d6becc205796630c23`.
- **Task:** `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, with **changed scope** recorded in [TASK.json](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77d29520c4f90a65787873d6becc205796630c23/research/helper300-eight-field-floor/TASK.json). The historical decoder card is narrowed to one possible paid-climb merge in the selected provider. Its 5% supplier-expansion gate is not claimed satisfied.
- **Nearest predecessor:** #5465 at `b123ff44a211b9fc96b9f8fd1538e9965a95b34e`, R13 §§3–4. This addresses changed ADD factorizations rather than another fixed-word reorder or one-swap search. The note's illustrative forward x19 witness is not used for the backward conclusion.
- **Source availability:** all proof/replay inputs are pinned on the canonical base in [SOURCES.json](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77d29520c4f90a65787873d6becc205796630c23/research/helper300-eight-field-floor/SOURCES.json). The #5465 note is an immutable motivation/overlap reference, not an unmerged Git-object dependency.
- **Coordination:** [canonical investigation and completed claim #5470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5470), linked from the handoff hub. Targeted overlap searches do not exclude unpublished work or hidden comments.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.14 on macOS arm64, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/helper300-eight-field-floor
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/helper300-eight-field-floor --check-source-history
```

Passed at the publication head:

- All four registered executions: both checkers in ordinary and optimized Python.
- Primary checker: exact transfer and source binding, invertible prefix grammar, all 16 monotone frame-path assignments per orientation, rejection of all seven cost-saving assignments, five controls, protected continuation checkpoints, and equality with committed `RESULT.json`. The inherited forward window is an orientation control; the selected-provider claim is backward.
- Separately authored checker: identical backward matrix, boundary frames, field set, 28 retained events and 10-H1 invoice; determinant 1, basis-vector replay, and nine rejected semantic mutations.
- Committed-byte and source-history preflight; committed-package export integrity check; all four direct checks in a fresh read-only export with Git absent from PATH. Ordinary/optimized outputs agree.

Finite checks establish the source-bound hypotheses and support the written carrier lemma; they are not an enumeration of arbitrary programs. No complete provider/caller or absolute-phase replay, compiler-funding calculation, Lean audit, independent human review, or new exponent calculation was performed. The selected construction is unchanged.

## Credit

Credit Cao Yifan's #4610 native word, Dillon Amburgey's #5402 coupled provider, Ali Romman's cached-centre relations, Chris R/Clear1nsight's #5413 completion and source validation, GamingPuzzled's #5465 bottleneck analysis, tomdif's historical #1286 helper-basis screen, and the retained native/compiler lineage. No priority claim is made for elementary cut-rank arguments.

Prepared by **apoursh**, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance from a coordinator, synthesis worker, separate mathematical auditor and separately authored source checker. AI-worker separation is not independent human review. New work is Apache-2.0; predecessor notices are retained.

## Open next questions

The package's [README next questions](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77d29520c4f90a65787873d6becc205796630c23/research/helper300-eight-field-floor/README.md#open-next-questions) and [TASK.json](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77d29520c4f90a65787873d6becc205796630c23/research/helper300-eight-field-floor/TASK.json) identify the next bounded problem: extending the same seed through **[9044,9137)** closes over **twenty fields**. First derive its entry/exit geometry, rank cuts and complete paid profile; a larger interface could alter the one-carrier obstruction, but no profitable rewrite is supplied. Changed transport or auxiliary fields require an explicitly priced new contract. These follow-ups are outside this PR.
